item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"c1","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"`save()` persists the retriever configuration needed to reuse the corpus-side state: `k`, `normalize`, and the full `corpus` text are written into `config.json`.","span_ids":["save_config"]},{"claim_id":"c2","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"`save()` also persists the precomputed corpus embedding matrix in `corpus_embeddings.npy`, and when a FAISS index exists it writes a `faiss_index.bin` file for that index.","span_ids":["save_config","save_faiss","test_save_files"]},{"claim_id":"c3","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"Reloading still requires the caller to provide an `embedder`: the saved config does not include one, `load()` takes `embedder` as an argument, and it restores `self.embedder` from that argument.","span_ids":["save_config","load_signature","load_config_embedder"]},{"claim_id":"c4","claim_type":"supporting","weight":10,"statement":"The saved config records whether a FAISS index existed, and `load()` only attempts to read `faiss_index.bin` when that flag is true and the file is present;
